name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task's "If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first" is a conditional order rule. Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard states it exactly: the exit may not be reached before a toggle. "Must" with no preference cue is hard. No Existence is needed because the task does not require reaching the exit, and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, it must have toggled the switch before then (the exit is not reached before the switch is flipped).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:

FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
